AI.method: CAPS结合SO(2)旋转进行相位对齐，使用三种加性门控路径：Riemann softmax、前缀乘积门和Clock基线。引入Clock机制作为学习的时间权重，通过共享的时间重要性概念来调制这些路径。整个注意力层保持线性复杂度。
AI.result: 在长短期预测基准测试中，CAPS超越了标准softmax和线性注意力机制，并在与七个强基线的比较中表现出竞争性性能，同时保持线性复杂度。
AI.conclusion: CAPS通过结构化设计有效解耦时间序列中的不同时间结构，结合相位对齐和多路径门控机制，在保持线性复杂度的同时实现了优于传统注意力机制的预测性能。

title: Parallel-Probe: Towards Efficient Parallel Thinking via 2D Probing
summary: Parallel thinking has emerged as a promising paradigm for reasoning, yet it imposes significant computational burdens. Existing efficiency methods primarily rely on local, per-trajectory signals and lack principled mechanisms to exploit global dynamics across parallel branches. We introduce 2D probing, an interface that exposes the width-depth dynamics of parallel thinking by periodically eliciting intermediate answers from all branches. Our analysis reveals three key insights: non-monotonic scaling across width-depth allocations, heterogeneous reasoning branch lengths, and early stabilization of global consensus. Guided by these insights, we introduce $\textbf{Parallel-Probe}$, a training-free controller designed to optimize online parallel thinking. Parallel-Probe employs consensus-based early stopping to regulate reasoning depth and deviation-based branch pruning to dynamically adjust width. Extensive experiments across three benchmarks and multiple models demonstrate that Parallel-Probe establishes a superior Pareto frontier for test-time scaling. Compared to standard majority voting, it reduces sequential tokens by up to $\textbf{35.8}$% and total token cost by over $\textbf{25.8}$% while maintaining competitive accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出Parallel-Probe方法，通过2D探测技术优化并行推理的宽度-深度动态，实现计算效率提升
AI.motivation: 并行推理虽然是有前景的推理范式，但计算负担重；现有效率方法主要依赖局部轨迹信号，缺乏利用并行分支间全局动态的原则性机制
AI.method: 引入2D探测接口周期性获取所有分支的中间答案，揭示宽度-深度动态；基于此设计Parallel-Probe控制器，采用共识早期停止调节推理深度，基于偏差的分支剪枝动态调整宽度
AI.result: 在三个基准测试和多个模型上的实验表明，Parallel-Probe建立了优越的测试时缩放帕累托前沿；相比标准多数投票，减少顺序令牌达35.8%，总令牌成本降低超过25.8%，同时保持竞争力准确率
AI.conclusion: 2D探测揭示了并行推理的关键动态特性，Parallel-Probe通过训练无关的控制器有效优化并行推理效率，为推理系统的实际部署提供了实用解决方案

title: TabPFN for Zero-shot Parametric Engineering Design Generation
summary: Deep generative models for engineering design often require substantial computational cost, large training datasets, and extensive retraining when design requirements or datasets change, limiting their applicability in real-world engineering design workflow. In this work, we propose a zero-shot generation framework for parametric engineering design based on TabPFN, enabling conditional design generation using only a limited number of reference samples and without any task-specific model training or fine-tuning. The proposed method generates design parameters sequentially conditioned on target performance indicators, providing a flexible alternative to conventional generative models. The effectiveness of the proposed approach is evaluated on three engineering design datasets, i.e., ship hull design, BlendedNet aircraft, and UIUC airfoil. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method achieves competitive diversity across highly structured parametric design spaces, remains robust to variations in sampling, resolution and parameter dimensionality of geometry generation, and achieves a low performance error (e.g., less than 2% in generated ship hull designs' performance). Compared with diffusion-based generative models, the proposed framework significantly reduces computational overhead and data requirements while preserving reliable generation performance. These results highlight the potential of zero-shot, data-efficient generation as a practical and efficient tool for engineering design, enabling rapid deployment, flexible adaptation to new design settings, and ease of integration into real-world engineering workflows.

AI.tldr: 提出基于TabPFN的零样本生成框架，用于参数化工程设计，无需任务特定训练，仅需少量参考样本即可根据目标性能指标生成设计参数。
AI.motivation: 传统深度生成模型在工程设计中存在计算成本高、需要大量训练数据、设计需求或数据集变化时需要重新训练等问题，限制了其在真实工程工作流程中的应用。
AI.method: 基于TabPFN的零样本生成框架，通过有限参考样本实现条件设计生成，无需任务特定模型训练或微调。该方法按顺序生成条件于目标性能指标的设计参数。
AI.result: 在船体设计、BlendedNet飞机和UIUC翼型三个数据集上验证，方法在高度结构化的参数设计空间中具有竞争力多样性，对采样、分辨率和参数维度变化保持鲁棒，性能误差低（如船体设计性能误差小于2%）。相比扩散模型显著降低计算开销和数据需求。
AI.conclusion: 该方法展示了零样本、数据高效生成作为工程设计实用工具的潜力，能够快速部署、灵活适应新设计设置，并易于集成到真实工程工作流程中。

title: Thinking Like a Doctor: Conversational Diagnosis through the Exploration of Diagnostic Knowledge Graphs
summary: Conversational diagnosis requires multi-turn history-taking, where an agent asks clarifying questions to refine differential diagnoses under incomplete information. Existing approaches often rely on the parametric knowledge of a model or assume that patients provide rich and concrete information, which is unrealistic. To address these limitations, we propose a conversational diagnosis system that explores a diagnostic knowledge graph to reason in two steps: (i) generating diagnostic hypotheses from the dialogue context, and (ii) verifying hypotheses through clarifying questions, which are repeated until a final diagnosis is reached. Since evaluating the system requires a realistic patient simulator that responds to the system's questions, we adopt a well-established simulator along with patient profiles from MIMIC-IV. We further adapt it to describe symptoms vaguely to reflect real-world patients during early clinical encounters. Experiments show improved diagnostic accuracy and efficiency over strong baselines, and evaluations by physicians support the realism of our simulator and the clinical utility of the generated questions. Our code will be released upon publication.

AI.tldr: 提出基于诊断知识图谱的对话式诊断系统，通过两步推理（生成假设和验证假设）提高诊断准确性，使用改进的患者模拟器评估系统性能。
AI.motivation: 现有对话诊断方法要么依赖模型的参数化知识，要么假设患者提供丰富具体的信息，这在现实中不切实际。需要解决信息不完整情况下的诊断问题。
AI.method: 提出对话式诊断系统，利用诊断知识图谱进行两步推理：1）从对话上下文生成诊断假设；2）通过澄清问题验证假设，重复此过程直至得出最终诊断。使用MIMIC-IV患者档案和改进的患者模拟器进行评估。
AI.result: 实验显示相比强基线方法，系统在诊断准确性和效率方面均有提升。医师评估支持模拟器的真实性和生成问题的临床实用性。
AI.conclusion: 提出的基于知识图谱的对话诊断系统能够有效处理信息不完整情况，通过迭代假设生成和验证提高诊断性能，具有临床实用价值。

title: Entropy-Guided Dynamic Tokens for Graph-LLM Alignment in Molecular Understanding
summary: Molecular understanding is central to advancing areas such as scientific discovery, yet Large Language Models (LLMs) struggle to understand molecular graphs effectively. Existing graph-LLM bridges often adapt the Q-Former-style connector with fixed-length static tokens, which is originally designed for vision tasks. These designs overlook stereochemistry and substructural context and typically require costly LLM-backbone fine-tuning, limiting efficiency and generalization. We introduce EDT-Former, an Entropy-guided Dynamic Token Transformer that generates tokens aligned with informative molecular patches, thereby preserving both local and global structural features for molecular graph understanding. Beyond prior approaches, EDT-Former enables alignment between frozen graph encoders and LLMs without tuning the LLM backbone (excluding the embedding layer), resulting in computationally efficient finetuning, and achieves stateof-the-art results on MoleculeQA, Molecule-oriented Mol-Instructions, and property prediction benchmarks (TDC, MoleculeNet), underscoring its effectiveness for scalable and generalizable multimodal molecular understanding

AI.tldr: EDT-Former是一种熵引导的动态令牌Transformer，通过生成与信息丰富的分子片段对齐的令牌，实现冻结图编码器与LLM的对齐，无需微调LLM主干，在多个分子理解基准上取得SOTA结果
AI.motivation: 现有图-LLM桥接方法通常采用为视觉任务设计的固定长度静态令牌的Q-Former风格连接器，这些设计忽略了立体化学和子结构上下文，且通常需要昂贵的LLM主干微调，限制了效率和泛化能力
AI.method: 提出EDT-Former（熵引导的动态令牌Transformer），生成与信息丰富的分子片段对齐的令牌，从而保留局部和全局结构特征，实现冻结图编码器与LLM的对齐，无需微调LLM主干（除嵌入层外）
AI.result: 在MoleculeQA、面向分子的Mol-Instructions以及性质预测基准（TDC、MoleculeNet）上取得最先进结果，证明了其可扩展和可泛化的多模态分子理解能力
AI.conclusion: EDT-Former通过熵引导的动态令牌生成，有效解决了现有图-LLM桥接方法的局限性，实现了高效、可泛化的分子图理解，为科学发现中的分子理解提供了有效解决方案

title: On the Sample Efficiency of Inverse Dynamics Models for Semi-Supervised Imitation Learning
summary: Semi-supervised imitation learning (SSIL) consists in learning a policy from a small dataset of action-labeled trajectories and a much larger dataset of action-free trajectories. Some SSIL methods learn an inverse dynamics model (IDM) to predict the action from the current state and the next state. An IDM can act as a policy when paired with a video model (VM-IDM) or as a label generator to perform behavior cloning on action-free data (IDM labeling). In this work, we first show that VM-IDM and IDM labeling learn the same policy in a limit case, which we call the IDM-based policy. We then argue that the previously observed advantage of IDM-based policies over behavior cloning is due to the superior sample efficiency of IDM learning, which we attribute to two causes: (i) the ground-truth IDM tends to be contained in a lower complexity hypothesis class relative to the expert policy, and (ii) the ground-truth IDM is often less stochastic than the expert policy. We argue these claims based on insights from statistical learning theory and novel experiments, including a study of IDM-based policies using recent architectures for unified video-action prediction (UVA). Motivated by these insights, we finally propose an improved version of the existing LAPO algorithm for latent action policy learning.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了半监督模仿学习中的逆动力学模型方法，揭示了VM-IDM和IDM标注在极限情况下学习相同策略，并指出IDM方法优于行为克隆的原因在于IDM学习的样本效率更高，这源于IDM假设空间复杂度更低且确定性更强。
AI.motivation: 研究半监督模仿学习中逆动力学模型方法的理论基础，解释为什么基于IDM的策略通常比行为克隆表现更好，并基于这些理论洞察改进现有的潜在动作策略学习算法。
AI.method: 1) 理论分析VM-IDM和IDM标注方法在极限情况下的等价性；2) 基于统计学习理论和实验验证IDM学习样本效率更高的两个原因：假设空间复杂度更低和确定性更强；3) 使用统一视频-动作预测架构进行实验验证；4) 基于这些洞察改进现有的LAPO算法。
AI.result: 1) 证明了VM-IDM和IDM标注在极限情况下学习相同的IDM-based策略；2) 通过理论和实验验证了IDM学习样本效率更高的两个原因；3) 提出了改进的LAPO算法用于潜在动作策略学习。
AI.conclusion: 基于IDM的半监督模仿学习方法优于行为克隆的主要原因是IDM学习的样本效率更高，这源于IDM假设空间复杂度更低且确定性更强。这些理论洞察为改进现有算法提供了基础，并有助于更好地理解半监督模仿学习的机制。

title: Privately Fine-Tuned LLMs Preserve Temporal Dynamics in Tabular Data
summary: Research on differentially private synthetic tabular data has largely focused on independent and identically distributed rows where each record corresponds to a unique individual. This perspective neglects the temporal complexity in longitudinal datasets, such as electronic health records, where a user contributes an entire (sub) table of sequential events. While practitioners might attempt to model such data by flattening user histories into high-dimensional vectors for use with standard marginal-based mechanisms, we demonstrate that this strategy is insufficient. Flattening fails to preserve temporal coherence even when it maintains valid marginal distributions. We introduce PATH, a novel generative framework that treats the full table as the unit of synthesis and leverages the autoregressive capabilities of privately fine-tuned large language models. Extensive evaluations show that PATH effectively captures long-range dependencies that traditional methods miss. Empirically, our method reduces the distributional distance to real trajectories by over 60% and reduces state transition errors by nearly 50% compared to leading marginal mechanisms while achieving similar marginal fidelity.

AI.tldr: PATH：一种用于纵向表格数据的差分隐私合成框架，通过私有微调大语言模型保持时间连贯性，相比传统边际机制显著提升轨迹分布保真度
AI.motivation: 现有差分隐私表格数据合成方法主要针对独立同分布行数据，忽略了纵向数据集（如电子健康记录）的时间复杂性，其中每个用户贡献整个顺序事件子表。传统方法将用户历史扁平化为高维向量会破坏时间连贯性。
AI.method: 提出PATH框架，将完整表格作为合成单元，利用私有微调大语言模型的自回归能力来生成保持时间依赖关系的合成数据。
AI.result: PATH能有效捕捉传统方法遗漏的长程依赖关系，相比领先的边际机制，将真实轨迹的分布距离减少60%以上，状态转移错误减少近50%，同时保持相似的边际保真度。
AI.conclusion: PATH框架为纵向表格数据的差分隐私合成提供了有效解决方案，通过将完整表格作为合成单元并利用大语言模型的自回归能力，显著提升了时间连贯性和轨迹保真度。

title: Provable Effects of Data Replay in Continual Learning: A Feature Learning Perspective
summary: Continual learning (CL) aims to train models on a sequence of tasks while retaining performance on previously learned ones. A core challenge in this setting is catastrophic forgetting, where new learning interferes with past knowledge. Among various mitigation strategies, data-replay methods, where past samples are periodically revisited, are considered simple yet effective, especially when memory constraints are relaxed. However, the theoretical effectiveness of full data replay, where all past data is accessible during training, remains largely unexplored. In this paper, we present a comprehensive theoretical framework for analyzing full data-replay training in continual learning from a feature learning perspective. Adopting a multi-view data model, we identify the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) as a critical factor affecting forgetting. Focusing on task-incremental binary classification across $M$ tasks, our analysis verifies two key conclusions: (1) forgetting can still occur under full replay when the cumulative noise from later tasks dominates the signal from earlier ones; and (2) with sufficient signal accumulation, data replay can recover earlier tasks-even if their initial learning was poor. Notably, we uncover a novel insight into task ordering: prioritizing higher-signal tasks not only facilitates learning of lower-signal tasks but also helps prevent catastrophic forgetting. We validate our theoretical findings through synthetic and real-world experiments that visualize the interplay between signal learning and noise memorization across varying SNRs and task correlation regimes.

AI.tldr: 该论文从特征学习角度建立了全数据回放持续学习的理论框架，发现即使全数据回放下遗忘仍会发生，但足够信号积累可恢复早期任务，并提出优先学习高信号任务有助于防止灾难性遗忘。
AI.motivation: 持续学习中的灾难性遗忘是核心挑战，数据回放方法被认为是简单有效的缓解策略。然而，全数据回放（所有历史数据可访问）的理论有效性尚未得到充分探索。本文旨在从特征学习角度建立全数据回放的理论分析框架，深入理解遗忘机制。
AI.method: 采用多视图数据模型，从特征学习角度分析全数据回放训练。聚焦于M个任务的增量式二元分类问题，将信号噪声比（SNR）作为影响遗忘的关键因素。通过理论分析验证两个关键结论，并揭示任务排序的新见解。
AI.result: 理论分析表明：1）即使在全数据回放下，当后续任务的累积噪声主导早期任务的信号时，遗忘仍会发生；2）通过足够的信号积累，数据回放可以恢复早期任务，即使其初始学习效果不佳。发现任务排序的新见解：优先学习高信号任务不仅有助于学习低信号任务，还能帮助防止灾难性遗忘。通过合成和真实世界实验验证了理论发现。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立了全数据回放持续学习的理论框架，揭示了信号噪声比在遗忘中的关键作用。发现即使全数据回放下遗忘仍可能发生，但信号积累可以恢复早期任务。提出任务排序策略：优先学习高信号任务有助于防止灾难性遗忘，为持续学习算法设计提供了理论指导。

title: Cross-Temporal Attention Fusion (CTAF) for Multimodal Physiological Signals in Self-Supervised Learning
summary: We study multimodal affect modeling when EEG and peripheral physiology are asynchronous, which most fusion methods ignore or handle with costly warping. We propose Cross-Temporal Attention Fusion (CTAF), a self-supervised module that learns soft bidirectional alignments between modalities and builds a robust clip embedding using time-aware cross attention, a lightweight fusion gate, and alignment-regularized contrastive objectives with optional weak supervision. On the K-EmoCon dataset, under leave-one-out cross-validation evaluation, CTAF yields higher cosine margins for matched pairs and better cross-modal token retrieval within one second, and it is competitive with the baseline on three-bin accuracy and macro-F1 while using few labels. Our contributions are a time-aware fusion mechanism that directly models correspondence, an alignment-driven self-supervised objective tailored to EEG and physiology, and an evaluation protocol that measures alignment quality itself. Our approach accounts for the coupling between the central and autonomic nervous systems in psychophysiological time series. These results indicate that CTAF is a strong step toward label-efficient, generalizable EEG-peripheral fusion under temporal asynchrony.

AI.tldr: CTAF是一种自监督跨时间注意力融合模块，用于处理EEG与周边生理信号之间的时间异步问题，通过学习软双向对齐和构建鲁棒的片段嵌入，实现标签高效的多模态情感建模。
AI.motivation: 大多数多模态融合方法忽略或需要昂贵的时间扭曲来处理EEG与周边生理信号之间的时间异步问题，而这两种信号分别来自中枢神经系统和自主神经系统，在心理生理时间序列中存在耦合关系但时间不同步。
AI.method: 提出Cross-Temporal Attention Fusion (CTAF)模块，包含：1) 时间感知的跨注意力机制学习模态间软双向对齐；2) 轻量级融合门构建鲁棒片段嵌入；3) 对齐正则化的对比学习目标，支持可选弱监督；4) 专门针对EEG和生理信号设计的对齐驱动自监督目标。
AI.result: 在K-EmoCon数据集上，采用留一法交叉验证：1) 匹配对获得更高的余弦边界；2) 一秒内实现更好的跨模态标记检索；3) 在三分类准确率和宏F1分数上与基线竞争，同时使用较少标签；4) 提出专门评估对齐质量的评价协议。
AI.conclusion: CTAF通过直接建模模态间对应关系的时间感知融合机制，为处理EEG与周边生理信号时间异步问题提供了标签高效、泛化性强的解决方案，是向更鲁棒的心理生理时间序列融合迈出的重要一步。

authors: Telmo de Menezes e Silva Filho
title: LEMON: Local Explanations via Modality-aware OptimizatioN
summary: Multimodal models are ubiquitous, yet existing explainability methods are often single-modal, architecture-dependent, or too computationally expensive to run at scale. We introduce LEMON (Local Explanations via Modality-aware OptimizatioN), a model-agnostic framework for local explanations of multimodal predictions. LEMON fits a single modality-aware surrogate with group-structured sparsity to produce unified explanations that disentangle modality-level contributions and feature-level attributions. The approach treats the predictor as a black box and is computationally efficient, requiring relatively few forward passes while remaining faithful under repeated perturbations. We evaluate LEMON on vision-language question answering and a clinical prediction task with image, text, and tabular inputs, comparing against representative multimodal baselines. Across backbones, LEMON achieves competitive deletion-based faithfulness while reducing black-box evaluations by 35-67 times and runtime by 2-8 times compared to strong multimodal baselines.

AI.tldr: LEMON是一个模型无关的多模态可解释性框架，通过模态感知优化生成局部解释，在保持忠实度的同时显著减少计算开销。
AI.motivation: 现有可解释性方法通常是单模态的、架构依赖的或计算成本过高，难以在大规模多模态模型上应用。
AI.method: LEMON采用模型无关方法，拟合具有组结构化稀疏性的模态感知替代模型，生成统一的解释，分离模态级贡献和特征级归因。
AI.result: 在视觉语言问答和临床预测任务上，LEMON在保持竞争性忠实度的同时，将黑盒评估减少35-67倍，运行时间减少2-8倍。
AI.conclusion: LEMON提供了一个高效、忠实且模型无关的多模态可解释性框架，能够在大规模应用中实用化多模态解释。

title: Structure-Preserving Learning Improves Geometry Generalization in Neural PDEs
summary: We aim to develop physics foundation models for science and engineering that provide real-time solutions to Partial Differential Equations (PDEs) which preserve structure and accuracy under adaptation to unseen geometries. To this end, we introduce General-Geometry Neural Whitney Forms (Geo-NeW): a data-driven finite element method. We jointly learn a differential operator and compatible reduced finite element spaces defined on the underlying geometry. The resulting model is solved to generate predictions, while exactly preserving physical conservation laws through Finite Element Exterior Calculus. Geometry enters the model as a discretized mesh both through a transformer-based encoding and as the basis for the learned finite element spaces. This explicitly connects the underlying geometry and imposed boundary conditions to the solution, providing a powerful inductive bias for learning neural PDEs, which we demonstrate improves generalization to unseen domains. We provide a novel parameterization of the constitutive model ensuring the existence and uniqueness of the solution. Our approach demonstrates state-of-the-art performance on several steady-state PDE benchmarks, and provides a significant improvement over conventional baselines on out-of-distribution geometries.

AI.tldr: Geo-NeW：一种数据驱动的有限元方法，通过联合学习微分算子和兼容的降阶有限元空间，在未见几何上保持物理守恒定律和精度。
AI.motivation: 开发用于科学和工程的物理基础模型，能够实时求解偏微分方程（PDEs），并在适应未见几何时保持结构和精度。
AI.method: 提出General-Geometry Neural Whitney Forms (Geo-NeW)：1）联合学习微分算子和兼容的降阶有限元空间；2）通过有限元外微积分精确保持物理守恒定律；3）使用基于transformer的编码和离散网格作为有限元空间基础；4）提供确保解存在唯一性的本构模型参数化方法。
AI.result: 在多个稳态PDE基准测试中达到最先进性能，在分布外几何上相比传统基线有显著改进。
AI.conclusion: Geo-NeW通过显式连接底层几何、边界条件和解，为学习神经PDE提供了强大的归纳偏置，提高了对未见域的泛化能力。

title: Causality--Δ: Jacobian-Based Dependency Analysis in Flow Matching Models
summary: Flow matching learns a velocity field that transports a base distribution to data. We study how small latent perturbations propagate through these flows and show that Jacobian-vector products (JVPs) provide a practical lens on dependency structure in the generated features. We derive closed-form expressions for the optimal drift and its Jacobian in Gaussian and mixture-of-Gaussian settings, revealing that even globally nonlinear flows admit local affine structure. In low-dimensional synthetic benchmarks, numerical JVPs recover the analytical Jacobians. In image domains, composing the flow with an attribute classifier yields an attribute-level JVP estimator that recovers empirical correlations on MNIST and CelebA. Conditioning on small classifier-Jacobian norms reduces correlations in a way consistent with a hypothesized common-cause structure, while we emphasize that this conditioning is not a formal do intervention.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了流匹配中潜在扰动如何通过流传播，利用雅可比-向量积分析生成特征的依赖结构，在合成和图像数据上验证了方法，并通过条件化分类器-雅可比范数来减少相关性。
AI.motivation: 研究流匹配中潜在扰动如何通过流传播，探索生成特征的依赖结构，为理解流模型的局部行为提供理论框架。
AI.method: 使用雅可比-向量积分析流匹配中的依赖结构；推导高斯和高斯混合设置中最优漂移及其雅可比的闭式解；在合成基准中计算数值JVP；在图像域中将流与属性分类器组合，构建属性级JVP估计器。
AI.result: 在低维合成基准中，数值JVP恢复了解析雅可比；在MNIST和CelebA上，属性级JVP估计器恢复了经验相关性；条件化小分类器-雅可比范数减少了相关性，与假设的共同因果结构一致。
AI.conclusion: 即使全局非线性流也允许局部仿射结构；JVP为分析流匹配中的依赖结构提供了实用工具；条件化分类器-雅可比范数可以操作相关性，但强调这不是正式的do干预。

title: Joint Learning of Hierarchical Neural Options and Abstract World Model
summary: Building agents that can perform new skills by composing existing skills is a long-standing goal of AI agent research. Towards this end, we investigate how to efficiently acquire a sequence of skills, formalized as hierarchical neural options. However, existing model-free hierarchical reinforcement algorithms need a lot of data. We propose a novel method, which we call AgentOWL (Option and World model Learning Agent), that jointly learns -- in a sample efficient way -- an abstract world model (abstracting across both states and time) and a set of hierarchical neural options. We show, on a subset of Object-Centric Atari games, that our method can learn more skills using much less data than baseline methods.

AI.tldr: AgentOWL：一种联合学习抽象世界模型和分层神经选项的样本高效方法，用于构建能够通过组合现有技能执行新技能的智能体
AI.motivation: 构建能够通过组合现有技能执行新技能的智能体是AI研究的长期目标。现有模型无关的分层强化学习算法需要大量数据，因此需要更高效的技能获取方法。
AI.method: 提出AgentOWL方法，联合学习抽象世界模型（在状态和时间上进行抽象）和分层神经选项集合。该方法在样本效率方面优于现有方法。
AI.result: 在Object-Centric Atari游戏子集上，AgentOWL方法能够使用比基线方法少得多的数据学习更多技能。
AI.conclusion: AgentOWL通过联合学习抽象世界模型和分层神经选项，实现了更高效的技能获取，为构建能够通过技能组合执行新任务的智能体提供了有效途径。

title: Membership Inference Attacks from Causal Principles
summary: Membership Inference Attacks (MIAs) are widely used to quantify training data memorization and assess privacy risks. Standard evaluation requires repeated retraining, which is computationally costly for large models. One-run methods (single training with randomized data inclusion) and zero-run methods (post hoc evaluation) are often used instead, though their statistical validity remains unclear. To address this gap, we frame MIA evaluation as a causal inference problem, defining memorization as the causal effect of including a data point in the training set. This novel formulation reveals and formalizes key sources of bias in existing protocols: one-run methods suffer from interference between jointly included points, while zero-run evaluations popular for LLMs are confounded by non-random membership assignment. We derive causal analogues of standard MIA metrics and propose practical estimators for multi-run, one-run, and zero-run regimes with non-asymptotic consistency guarantees. Experiments on real-world data show that our approach enables reliable memorization measurement even when retraining is impractical and under distribution shift, providing a principled foundation for privacy evaluation in modern AI systems.

AI.tldr: 该论文将成员推理攻击评估重新定义为因果推断问题，提出具有统计保证的可靠记忆化测量方法，解决了现有单次和零次评估方法的偏差问题。
AI.motivation: 现有成员推理攻击评估方法存在统计有效性问题：标准评估需要重复训练（计算成本高），而单次训练方法和零次训练方法虽然实用但统计有效性不明确。需要为隐私评估提供理论基础。
AI.method: 将MIA评估框架化为因果推断问题，将记忆化定义为数据点包含在训练集中的因果效应。推导标准MIA指标的因果类比，提出具有非渐近一致性保证的多轮、单轮和零轮机制的实际估计器。
AI.result: 在真实世界数据上的实验表明，该方法即使在重训练不切实际和分布偏移的情况下，也能实现可靠的记忆化测量，为现代AI系统的隐私评估提供了原则性基础。
AI.conclusion: 通过因果推断框架，论文揭示了现有评估协议的关键偏差来源，提供了具有统计保证的可靠记忆化测量方法，为隐私评估建立了原则性基础。

title: From Tokens to Numbers: Continuous Number Modeling for SVG Generation
summary: For certain image generation tasks, vector graphics such as Scalable Vector Graphics (SVGs) offer clear benefits such as increased flexibility, size efficiency, and editing ease, but remain less explored than raster-based approaches. A core challenge is that the numerical, geometric parameters, which make up a large proportion of SVGs, are inefficiently encoded as long sequences of tokens. This slows training, reduces accuracy, and hurts generalization. To address these problems, we propose Continuous Number Modeling (CNM), an approach that directly models numbers as first-class, continuous values rather than discrete tokens. This formulation restores the mathematical elegance of the representation by aligning the model's inputs with the data's continuous nature, removing discretization artifacts introduced by token-based encoding. We then train a multimodal transformer on 2 million raster-to-SVG samples, followed by fine-tuning via reinforcement learning using perceptual feedback to further improve visual quality. Our approach improves training speed by over 30% while maintaining higher perceptual fidelity compared to alternative approaches. This work establishes CNM as a practical and efficient approach for high-quality vector generation, with potential for broader applications. We make our code available http://github.com/mikeogezi/CNM.

AI.tldr: 提出Continuous Number Modeling (CNM)方法，直接建模SVG中的连续数值参数而非离散token，提升向量图形生成效率和质量
AI.motivation: 向量图形（如SVG）在灵活性、尺寸效率和编辑便捷性方面优于栅格图形，但现有方法将SVG的几何参数编码为长token序列，导致训练缓慢、精度降低和泛化能力差
AI.method: 提出Continuous Number Modeling (CNM)方法，将数值作为连续值直接建模而非离散token；在200万个栅格到SVG样本上训练多模态transformer，然后通过强化学习使用感知反馈进行微调以提升视觉质量
AI.result: CNM方法将训练速度提升30%以上，同时保持比替代方法更高的感知保真度；建立了高质量向量生成的实用高效方法
AI.conclusion: CNM为高质量向量生成提供了实用高效的方法，具有更广泛应用的潜力；代码已开源

title: A Single Revision Step Improves Token-Efficient LLM Reasoning
summary:
Large language models (LLMs) achieve higher accuracy on challenging reasoning tasks by scaling test-time compute through multiple trajectory sampling. However, standard aggregation methods like majority voting or individual confidence-based filtering face a fundamental "blind spot": they evaluate each trace in isolation. As problems scale in difficulty, models often generate hallucinated paths that exhibit misleadingly high confidence, causing the true solution to be suppressed by a narrow margin in traditional voting. We ask: can we enable traces to "peer-review" each other to resolve these near-miss errors?
  We introduce Packet-Conditioned Revision (PACER), a training-free, inference-only framework that enables reasoning traces to revise their conclusions through a structured coordination step. After a preliminary screening of generated traces, PACER constructs a compact consensus packet containing (i) unique candidate answers, (ii) their aggregated confidence scores, and (iii) representative reasoning summaries for each candidate answer. Individual traces then perform a targeted self-review conditioned on this packet, allowing them to identify specific logical junctions where they diverged from the broader consensus and pivot if their original reasoning is found to be flawed. Final predictions are obtained via confidence-weighted voting over these revised trajectories. On challenging competitive math benchmarks such as AIME and BRUMO, PACER matches or exceeds the accuracy of 256-sample majority voting, significantly outperforming raw ensemble baselines by transforming simple consensus into a collaborative logical refinement process.

AI.tldr: PACER框架通过让推理轨迹相互"同行评审"来解决LLM在复杂推理任务中的"盲点"问题，显著提升准确率
AI.motivation: 传统多数投票或基于置信度过滤的方法存在"盲点"：它们孤立评估每个推理轨迹。随着问题难度增加，模型常生成具有误导性高置信度的幻觉路径，导致真实解在传统投票中被微弱优势压制
AI.method: 提出Packet-Conditioned Revision (PACER)框架：1) 对生成的推理轨迹进行初步筛选；2) 构建包含独特候选答案、聚合置信度分数和代表性推理摘要的共识包；3) 各轨迹基于此包进行针对性自我审查，识别与共识的逻辑分歧点并修正；4) 通过置信度加权投票获得最终预测
AI.result: 在AIME和BRUMO等竞争性数学基准测试中，PACER匹配或超越256样本多数投票的准确率，显著优于原始集成基线
AI.conclusion: PACER将简单共识转化为协作逻辑精炼过程，通过让推理轨迹相互"同行评审"有效解决传统聚合方法的盲点问题，显著提升LLM在复杂推理任务中的表现

title: Self-Hinting Language Models Enhance Reinforcement Learning
summary: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has recently emerged as a practical recipe for aligning large language models with verifiable objectives. However, under sparse terminal rewards, GRPO often stalls because rollouts within a group frequently receive identical rewards, causing relative advantages to collapse and updates to vanish. We propose self-hint aligned GRPO with privileged supervision (SAGE), an on-policy reinforcement learning framework that injects privileged hints during training to reshape the rollout distribution under the same terminal verifier reward. For each prompt $x$, the model samples a compact hint $h$ (e.g., a plan or decomposition) and then generates a solution $τ$ conditioned on $(x,h)$. Crucially, the task reward $R(x,τ)$ is unchanged; hints only increase within-group outcome diversity under finite sampling, preventing GRPO advantages from collapsing under sparse rewards. At test time, we set $h=\varnothing$ and deploy the no-hint policy without any privileged information. Moreover, sampling diverse self-hints serves as an adaptive curriculum that tracks the learner's bottlenecks more effectively than fixed hints from an initial policy or a stronger external model. Experiments over 6 benchmarks with 3 LLMs show that SAGE consistently outperforms GRPO, on average +2.0 on Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct, +1.2 on Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and +1.3 on Qwen3-4B-Instruct. The code is available at https://github.com/BaohaoLiao/SAGE.

AI.tldr: SAGE通过引入特权提示增强GRPO在稀疏奖励下的训练效果，通过采样多样化提示增加组内结果多样性，防止优势函数坍缩，测试时无需提示。
AI.motivation: GRPO在稀疏终端奖励下容易停滞，因为组内rollout常获得相同奖励，导致相对优势坍缩和更新消失。需要解决稀疏奖励下GRPO训练效率低下的问题。
AI.method: 提出SAGE框架：训练时对每个提示x采样紧凑提示h（如计划或分解），生成基于(x,h)的解决方案τ。任务奖励R(x,τ)保持不变，提示仅增加有限采样下的组内结果多样性。测试时设置h=∅部署无提示策略。多样化自提示作为自适应课程，比固定提示更有效跟踪学习瓶颈。
AI.result: 在6个基准测试和3个LLM上的实验显示，SAGE始终优于GRPO：Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct平均+2.0，Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct平均+1.2，Qwen3-4B-Instruct平均+1.3。
AI.conclusion: SAGE通过特权提示增强GRPO在稀疏奖励下的训练效果，通过增加组内多样性防止优势函数坍缩，且测试时无需特权信息，实现了更好的对齐性能。

title: SC3D: Dynamic and Differentiable Causal Discovery for Temporal and Instantaneous Graphs
summary: Discovering causal structures from multivariate time series is a key problem because interactions span across multiple lags and possibly involve instantaneous dependencies. Additionally, the search space of the dynamic graphs is combinatorial in nature. In this study, we propose \textit{Stable Causal Dynamic Differentiable Discovery (SC3D)}, a two-stage differentiable framework that jointly learns lag-specific adjacency matrices and, if present, an instantaneous directed acyclic graph (DAG). In Stage 1, SC3D performs edge preselection through node-wise prediction to obtain masks for lagged and instantaneous edges, whereas Stage 2 refines these masks by optimizing a likelihood with sparsity along with enforcing acyclicity on the instantaneous block. Numerical results across synthetic and benchmark dynamical systems demonstrate that SC3D achieves improved stability and more accurate recovery of both lagged and instantaneous causal structures compared to existing temporal baselines.

AI.tldr: SC3D是一个两阶段可微分框架，用于从多元时间序列中发现跨多个滞后的因果结构和瞬时依赖关系，通过边缘预选和优化提高稳定性和准确性。
AI.motivation: 从多元时间序列中发现因果结构具有挑战性，因为交互跨越多个滞后且可能涉及瞬时依赖关系，同时动态图的搜索空间本质上是组合性的。
AI.method: 提出SC3D两阶段可微分框架：第一阶段通过节点预测进行边缘预选，获得滞后和瞬时边缘的掩码；第二阶段通过优化稀疏性似然并强制瞬时块的无环性来细化这些掩码。
AI.result: 在合成和基准动态系统上的数值结果表明，SC3D相比现有时间基线方法，在滞后和瞬时因果结构的恢复方面实现了更高的稳定性和准确性。
AI.conclusion: SC3D框架能够有效处理多元时间序列中的跨滞后因果发现和瞬时依赖关系，在复杂动态系统中表现出优越的因果结构恢复能力。

title: DynSplit-KV: Dynamic Semantic Splitting for KVCache Compression in Efficient Long-Context LLM Inference
summary: Although Key-Value (KV) Cache is essential for efficient large language models (LLMs) inference, its growing memory footprint in long-context scenarios poses a significant bottleneck, making KVCache compression crucial. Current compression methods rely on rigid splitting strategies, such as fixed intervals or pre-defined delimiters. We observe that rigid splitting suffers from significant accuracy degradation (ranging from 5.5% to 55.1%) across different scenarios, owing to the scenario-dependent nature of the semantic boundaries. This highlights the necessity of dynamic semantic splitting to match semantics. To achieve this, we face two challenges. (1) Improper delimiter selection misaligns semantics with the KVCache, resulting in 28.6% accuracy loss. (2) Variable-length blocks after splitting introduce over 73.1% additional inference overhead. To address the above challenges, we propose DynSplit-KV, a KVCache compression method that dynamically identifies delimiters for splitting. We propose: (1) a dynamic importance-aware delimiter selection strategy, improving accuracy by 49.9%. (2) A uniform mapping strategy that transforms variable-length semantic blocks into a fixed-length format, reducing inference overhead by 4.9x. Experiments show that DynSplit-KV achieves the highest accuracy, 2.2x speedup compared with FlashAttention and 2.6x peak memory reduction in long-context scenarios.

AI.tldr: DynSplit-KV：一种动态语义分割的KV缓存压缩方法，通过重要性感知的分隔符选择和统一映射策略，在长上下文场景中实现高精度、低内存占用和快速推理。
AI.motivation: KV缓存在大语言模型推理中至关重要，但在长上下文场景中内存占用急剧增长成为瓶颈。现有压缩方法采用固定间隔或预定义分隔符的刚性分割策略，在不同场景下会导致5.5%到55.1%的精度损失，因为语义边界具有场景依赖性，需要动态语义分割来匹配语义。
AI.method: 提出DynSplit-KV方法：1）动态重要性感知分隔符选择策略，通过动态识别语义边界的分隔符，将精度提升49.9%；2）统一映射策略，将变长语义块转换为固定长度格式，减少73.1%的推理开销，实现4.9倍的推理加速。
AI.result: 实验表明，DynSplit-KV在长上下文场景中实现了最高精度，相比FlashAttention获得2.2倍加速，峰值内存减少2.6倍，同时解决了刚性分割导致的精度损失问题。
AI.conclusion: DynSplit-KV通过动态语义分割有效解决了KV缓存压缩中的精度损失和推理开销问题，为长上下文LLM推理提供了高效的内存优化解决方案。

title: Tabula RASA: Exposing and Breaking the Relational Bottleneck in Transformers
summary: Transformers achieve remarkable performance across many domains, yet struggle with tasks requiring multi-hop relational reasoning over structured data. We analyze this limitation through circuit complexity: standard transformers are $\mathsf{TC}^0$-complete and require $Ω(k)$ layers for $k$-hop reasoning. We introduce RASA (Relation-Aware Sparse Attention), a minimal modification adding: (1) edge-type embeddings that inject relational structure into attention scores, and (2) sparse masking that restricts attention to graph-adjacent positions. While RASA has the same asymptotic depth requirements, sparse masking reduces the attention search space from $O(2^{n^2})$ to $O(2^m)$ patterns, and edge biases provide explicit relation routing. Empirically, on MetaQA (1/2/3-hop) and WebQuestionsSP, RASA outperforms standard transformers and matches GPT-4 at lower cost, with advantages growing with reasoning depth (+7.1 points on 3-hop). We do not claim formal learnability guarantees; the contribution is empirical validation that minimal structural modifications substantially improve multi-hop reasoning.

AI.tldr: RASA通过在标准Transformer中引入边类型嵌入和图邻接稀疏掩码，显著提升了多跳关系推理能力，在MetaQA和WebQuestionsSP上超越标准Transformer并接近GPT-4性能。
AI.motivation: 标准Transformer在处理需要结构化数据上进行多跳关系推理的任务时表现有限，这源于其电路复杂度限制：标准Transformer是TC^0完全的，需要Ω(k)层进行k跳推理。
AI.method: 提出RASA（关系感知稀疏注意力），包含两个关键修改：1）边类型嵌入：将关系结构注入注意力分数；2）稀疏掩码：将注意力限制在图邻接位置上。
AI.result: 在MetaQA（1/2/3跳）和WebQuestionsSP上，RASA优于标准Transformer，性能接近GPT-4但成本更低，且推理深度越大优势越明显（3跳任务提升7.1分）。稀疏掩码将注意力搜索空间从O(2^{n^2})减少到O(2^m)。
AI.conclusion: 虽然RASA具有相同的渐近深度要求，但最小结构修改能显著改善多跳关系推理，为Transformer架构的改进提供了实证支持。

title: Prompt Augmentation Scales up GRPO Training on Mathematical Reasoning
summary: Reinforcement learning algorithms such as group-relative policy optimization (GRPO) have demonstrated strong potential for improving the mathematical reasoning capabilities of large language models. However, prior work has consistently observed an entropy collapse phenomenon during reinforcement post-training, characterized by a monotonic decrease in policy entropy that ultimately leads to training instability and collapse. As a result, most existing approaches restrict training to short horizons (typically 5-20 epochs), limiting sustained exploration and hindering further policy improvement. In addition, nearly all prior work relies on a single, fixed reasoning prompt or template during training. In this work, we introduce prompt augmentation, a training strategy that instructs the model to generate reasoning traces under diverse templates and formats, thereby increasing rollout diversity. We show that, without a KL regularization term, prompt augmentation enables stable scaling of training duration under a fixed dataset and allows the model to tolerate low-entropy regimes without premature collapse. Empirically, a Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B model trained with prompt augmentation on the MATH Level 3-5 dataset achieves state-of-the-art performance, reaching 44.5 per-benchmark accuracy and 51.3 per-question accuracy on standard mathematical reasoning benchmarks, including AIME24, AMC, MATH500, Minerva, and OlympiadBench. The code and model checkpoints are available at https://github.com/wenquanlu/prompt-augmentation-GRPO.

AI.tldr: 提出提示增强训练策略，通过多样化推理模板解决强化学习后训练中的熵崩溃问题，实现稳定长时训练并提升数学推理性能
AI.motivation: 现有强化学习后训练方法存在熵崩溃现象，导致训练不稳定和崩溃，限制了训练时长（通常仅5-20轮），同时依赖单一固定的推理提示模板，限制了模型探索能力
AI.method: 引入提示增强训练策略，指导模型在多样化模板和格式下生成推理轨迹，增加rollout多样性；无需KL正则项即可实现稳定长时训练，使模型能够容忍低熵状态而不提前崩溃
AI.result: 在MATH Level 3-5数据集上训练的Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B模型达到最先进性能：基准准确率44.5%，问题准确率51.3%，在AIME24、AMC、MATH500、Minerva和OlympiadBench等标准数学推理基准上表现优异
AI.conclusion: 提示增强策略有效解决了强化学习后训练中的熵崩溃问题，实现了稳定长时训练，显著提升了数学推理模型的性能，为强化学习在语言模型中的应用提供了新思路

title: Semantics-Aware Generative Latent Data Augmentation for Learning in Low-Resource Domains
summary: Despite strong performance in data-rich regimes, deep learning often underperforms in the data-scarce settings common in practice. While foundation models (FMs) trained on massive datasets demonstrate strong generalization by extracting general-purpose features, they can still suffer from scarce labeled data during downstream fine-tuning. To address this, we propose GeLDA, a semantics-aware generative latent data augmentation framework that leverages conditional diffusion models to synthesize samples in an FM-induced latent space. Because this space is low-dimensional and concentrates task-relevant information compared to the input space, GeLDA enables efficient, high-quality data generation. GeLDA conditions generation on auxiliary feature vectors that capture semantic relationships among classes or subdomains, facilitating data augmentation in low-resource domains. We validate GeLDA in two large-scale recognition tasks: (a) in zero-shot language-specific speech emotion recognition, GeLDA improves the Whisper-large baseline's unweighted average recall by 6.13%; and (b) in long-tailed image classification, it achieves 74.7% tail-class accuracy on ImageNet-LT, setting a new state-of-the-art result.

AI.tldr: GeLDA是一种语义感知的生成式潜在数据增强框架，利用条件扩散模型在基础模型诱导的潜在空间中合成样本，以解决数据稀缺问题。
AI.motivation: 尽管深度学习在数据丰富场景下表现优异，但在实际应用中常见的数据稀缺场景下往往表现不佳。基础模型虽然通过大规模数据训练获得了强大的泛化能力，但在下游微调时仍面临标注数据稀缺的问题。
AI.method: GeLDA框架在基础模型诱导的潜在空间中使用条件扩散模型生成样本。该潜在空间维度较低且集中了任务相关信息，相比输入空间能实现高效高质量的数据生成。框架通过捕捉类别或子域间语义关系的辅助特征向量来条件化生成过程。
AI.result: 在零样本语言特定语音情感识别任务中，GeLDA将Whisper-large基线的未加权平均召回率提高了6.13%；在长尾图像分类任务中，在ImageNet-LT上实现了74.7%的尾部类别准确率，创造了新的最先进结果。
AI.conclusion: GeLDA通过利用基础模型的潜在空间和条件扩散模型，有效解决了数据稀缺场景下的深度学习性能问题，在语音情感识别和图像分类任务中均取得了显著改进。

title: Merging Beyond: Streaming LLM Updates via Activation-Guided Rotations
summary: The escalating scale of Large Language Models (LLMs) necessitates efficient adaptation techniques. Model merging has gained prominence for its efficiency and controllability. However, existing merging techniques typically serve as post-hoc refinements or focus on mitigating task interference, often failing to capture the dynamic optimization benefits of supervised fine-tuning (SFT). In this work, we propose Streaming Merging, an innovative model updating paradigm that conceptualizes merging as an iterative optimization process. Central to this paradigm is \textbf{ARM} (\textbf{A}ctivation-guided \textbf{R}otation-aware \textbf{M}erging), a strategy designed to approximate gradient descent dynamics. By treating merging coefficients as learning rates and deriving rotation vectors from activation subspaces, ARM effectively steers parameter updates along data-driven trajectories. Unlike conventional linear interpolation, ARM aligns semantic subspaces to preserve the geometric structure of high-dimensional parameter evolution. Remarkably, ARM requires only early SFT checkpoints and, through iterative merging, surpasses the fully converged SFT model. Experimental results across model scales (1.7B to 14B) and diverse domains (e.g., math, code) demonstrate that ARM can transcend converged checkpoints. Extensive experiments show that ARM provides a scalable and lightweight framework for efficient model adaptation.

AI.tldr: Streaming Merging是一种创新的模型更新范式，将模型合并视为迭代优化过程，通过ARM策略近似梯度下降动态，仅需早期SFT检查点即可超越完全收敛的SFT模型。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型规模不断扩大，需要高效的适应技术。现有合并技术通常作为事后优化或专注于缓解任务干扰，未能捕捉监督微调（SFT）的动态优化优势。
AI.method: 提出Streaming Merging范式，核心是ARM策略：将合并系数视为学习率，从激活子空间推导旋转向量，引导参数沿数据驱动轨迹更新。ARM对齐语义子空间以保持高维参数演化的几何结构。
AI.result: 实验在1.7B到14B模型规模和数学、代码等多样领域进行，ARM仅需早期SFT检查点，通过迭代合并即可超越完全收敛的SFT模型，提供可扩展的轻量级框架。
AI.conclusion: ARM为高效模型适应提供了可扩展的轻量级框架，将合并概念化为迭代优化过程，能够超越传统收敛检查点，在模型适应方面具有显著优势。

title: Causal Flow Q-Learning for Robust Offline Reinforcement Learning
summary: Expressive policies based on flow-matching have been successfully applied in reinforcement learning (RL) more recently due to their ability to model complex action distributions from offline data. These algorithms build on standard policy gradients, which assume that there is no unmeasured confounding in the data. However, this condition does not necessarily hold for pixel-based demonstrations when a mismatch exists between the demonstrator's and the learner's sensory capabilities, leading to implicit confounding biases in offline data. We address the challenge by investigating the problem of confounded observations in offline RL from a causal perspective. We develop a novel causal offline RL objective that optimizes policies' worst-case performance that may arise due to confounding biases. Based on this new objective, we introduce a practical implementation that learns expressive flow-matching policies from confounded demonstrations, employing a deep discriminator to assess the discrepancy between the target policy and the nominal behavioral policy. Experiments across 25 pixel-based tasks demonstrate that our proposed confounding-robust augmentation procedure achieves a success rate 120\% that of confounding-unaware, state-of-the-art offline RL methods.

AI.tldr: 提出一种针对像素观测中混杂偏倚的鲁棒离线强化学习方法，通过因果视角处理演示者与学习者感官能力不匹配导致的混杂观测问题
AI.motivation: 基于流匹配的表达性策略在离线强化学习中表现出色，但传统方法假设数据无混杂，而像素演示中演示者与学习者感官能力不匹配会导致混杂偏倚，现有方法无法处理这种混杂观测问题
AI.method: 从因果视角分析混杂观测问题，提出新的因果离线强化学习目标，优化策略在混杂偏倚下的最坏情况性能，使用深度判别器评估目标策略与名义行为策略的差异，实现从混杂演示中学习流匹配策略
AI.result: 在25个像素任务上的实验表明，提出的混杂鲁棒增强方法比不考虑混杂的先进离线强化学习方法成功率提高120%
AI.conclusion: 通过因果视角处理混杂观测问题，提出的方法能够有效从混杂演示中学习表达性策略，显著提升像素任务中的性能表现

title: R1-SyntheticVL: Is Synthetic Data from Generative Models Ready for Multimodal Large Language Model?
summary: In this work, we aim to develop effective data synthesis techniques that autonomously synthesize multimodal training data for enhancing MLLMs in solving complex real-world tasks. To this end, we propose Collective Adversarial Data Synthesis (CADS), a novel and general approach to synthesize high-quality, diverse and challenging multimodal data for MLLMs. The core idea of CADS is to leverage collective intelligence to ensure high-quality and diverse generation, while exploring adversarial learning to synthesize challenging samples for effectively driving model improvement. Specifically, CADS operates with two cyclic phases, i.e., Collective Adversarial Data Generation (CAD-Generate) and Collective Adversarial Data Judgment (CAD-Judge). CAD-Generate leverages collective knowledge to jointly generate new and diverse multimodal data, while CAD-Judge collaboratively assesses the quality of synthesized data. In addition, CADS introduces an Adversarial Context Optimization mechanism to optimize the generation context to encourage challenging and high-value data generation. With CADS, we construct MMSynthetic-20K and train our model R1-SyntheticVL, which demonstrates superior performance on various benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出CADS方法，通过集体对抗数据合成技术自动生成高质量、多样化、具有挑战性的多模态训练数据，用于增强多模态大语言模型的复杂任务解决能力。
AI.motivation: 开发有效的数据合成技术，自主合成多模态训练数据，以增强多模态大语言模型在解决复杂现实任务中的能力。现有方法在生成高质量、多样化且具有挑战性的数据方面存在不足。
AI.method: 提出集体对抗数据合成（CADS）方法，包含两个循环阶段：集体对抗数据生成（CAD-Generate）和集体对抗数据判断（CAD-Judge）。CAD-Generate利用集体知识联合生成新颖多样的多模态数据；CAD-Judge协作评估合成数据质量。此外引入对抗上下文优化机制，优化生成上下文以鼓励挑战性高价值数据生成。
AI.result: 使用CADS构建了MMSynthetic-20K数据集，并训练了R1-SyntheticVL模型。该模型在多个基准测试中表现出优越性能。
AI.conclusion: CADS是一种新颖通用的方法，能够合成高质量、多样化且具有挑战性的多模态数据，有效驱动多模态大语言模型的性能提升，为解决复杂现实任务提供了有效的数据增强方案。

title: Zero Sum SVD: Balancing Loss Sensitivity for Low Rank LLM Compression
summary: Advances in large language models have driven strong performance across many tasks, but their memory and compute costs still hinder deployment. SVD-based compression reduces storage and can speed up inference via low-rank factors, yet performance depends on how rank is allocated under a global compression ratio. Prior methods often use homogeneous ranks for similarly sized matrices, despite large differences in loss sensitivity, or rely on expensive iterative pre-truncation optimization to determine per matrix ranks. We propose \textbf{Zero Sum SVD} (\textbf{ZS-SVD}), a post-training method that performs \emph{global} singular component selection using activation whitening and first-order calibration loss estimates in whitened coordinates. \textbf{ZS-SVD} prunes components across the whole model with a \textbf{zero sum} rule that keeps the cumulative predicted loss change near zero, automatically yielding heterogeneous ranks without solving a rank allocation optimization. Motivated by evidence that gradients near pretrained solutions exhibit low rank structure, we also introduce an optional lightweight correction that applies a \textbf{single} projected gradient update after truncation, followed by re-truncation. Extensive experiments across multiple LLM architectures show consistent gains across diverse benchmarks and compression ratios. Code is available at https://github.com/mint-vu/Zero-Sum-SVD

AI.tldr: ZS-SVD是一种后训练SVD压缩方法，通过激活白化和一阶校准损失估计进行全局奇异分量选择，使用零和规则自动分配异构秩，无需显式优化
AI.motivation: 现有SVD压缩方法通常对相似尺寸矩阵使用同质秩分配，忽略了损失敏感性的巨大差异，或者依赖昂贵的迭代预截断优化来确定每矩阵秩，需要更高效的后训练压缩方法
AI.method: 提出ZS-SVD：1) 使用激活白化和白化坐标中的一阶校准损失估计进行全局奇异分量选择；2) 采用零和规则在整个模型中剪枝分量，保持累积预测损失变化接近零，自动产生异构秩；3) 可选轻量级校正：应用单次投影梯度更新后重新截断
AI.result: 在多种LLM架构上的广泛实验显示，在不同基准测试和压缩比下均获得一致性能提升
AI.conclusion: ZS-SVD是一种高效的后训练SVD压缩方法，通过全局奇异分量选择和零和规则自动分配异构秩，无需显式优化，在保持性能的同时显著降低计算和存储成本

title: Robustness as an Emergent Property of Task Performance
summary: Robustness is often regarded as a critical future challenge for real-world applications, where stability is essential. However, as models often learn tasks in a similar order, we hypothesize that easier tasks will be easier regardless of how they are presented to the model. Indeed, in this paper, we show that as models approach high performance on a task, robustness is effectively achieved. Through an empirical analysis of multiple models across diverse datasets and configurations (e.g., paraphrases, different temperatures), we find a strong positive correlation. Moreover, we find that robustness is primarily driven by task-specific competence rather than inherent model-level properties, challenging current approaches that treat robustness as an independent capability. Thus, from a high-level perspective, we may expect that as new tasks saturate, model robustness on these tasks will emerge accordingly. For researchers, this implies that explicit efforts to measure and improve robustness may warrant reduced emphasis, as such robustness is likely to develop alongside performance gains. For practitioners, it acts as a sign that indeed the tasks that the literature deals with are unreliable, but on easier past tasks, the models are reliable and ready for real-world deployment.

AI.tldr: 论文发现模型在任务上达到高性能时，鲁棒性也会自然实现，两者存在强正相关，无需单独关注鲁棒性改进
AI.motivation: 研究模型鲁棒性是否与任务性能相关，挑战当前将鲁棒性视为独立能力的观点，探索模型在真实应用中稳定性的本质
AI.method: 通过实证分析多个模型在多样化数据集和配置（如改写、不同温度参数）下的表现，研究任务性能与鲁棒性之间的相关性
AI.result: 发现任务性能与鲁棒性存在强正相关，鲁棒性主要由任务特定能力驱动而非模型固有属性，当模型在任务上达到高表现时鲁棒性自然实现
AI.conclusion: 随着新任务性能饱和，模型在这些任务上的鲁棒性将相应涌现，研究者可减少对鲁棒性测量的显式关注，实践者可信任模型在已掌握任务上的可靠性

title: When pre-training hurts LoRA fine-tuning: a dynamical analysis via single-index models
summary: Pre-training on a source task is usually expected to facilitate fine-tuning on similar downstream problems. In this work, we mathematically show that this naive intuition is not always true: excessive pre-training can computationally slow down fine-tuning optimization. We study this phenomenon for low-rank adaptation (LoRA) fine-tuning on single-index models trained under one-pass SGD. Leveraging a summary statistics description of the fine-tuning dynamics, we precisely characterize how the convergence rate depends on the initial fine-tuning alignment and the degree of non-linearity of the target task. The key take away is that even when the pre-training and down- stream tasks are well aligned, strong pre-training can induce a prolonged search phase and hinder convergence. Our theory thus provides a unified picture of how pre-training strength and task difficulty jointly shape the dynamics and limitations of LoRA fine-tuning in a nontrivial tractable model.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过理论分析表明，过度预训练可能反而会减缓下游任务的微调优化速度，特别是在LoRA微调场景下。
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为预训练总是有助于下游任务的微调，但作者发现这种直觉并不总是成立。他们旨在从理论上探究预训练强度如何影响微调优化动态，特别是在什么情况下过度预训练反而会阻碍收敛。
AI.method: 采用单索引模型（single-index models）作为理论分析框架，在单次SGD训练下研究LoRA（低秩适应）微调动态。通过构建微调动态的统计摘要描述，精确表征收敛速率如何依赖于初始微调对齐度和目标任务非线性程度。
AI.result: 理论分析表明，即使预训练任务与下游任务对齐良好，过强的预训练也可能导致微调过程中出现延长的搜索阶段，从而阻碍收敛。收敛速率受初始对齐度和非线性程度的共同影响。
AI.conclusion: 预训练强度与任务难度共同塑造了LoRA微调动态的局限性。过度预训练可能产生反效果，这为理解预训练-微调范式提供了统一的理论框架，并揭示了在特定条件下预训练可能不利于下游任务优化的非平凡现象。

title: MeKi: Memory-based Expert Knowledge Injection for Efficient LLM Scaling
summary: Scaling Large Language Models (LLMs) typically relies on increasing the number of parameters or test-time computations to boost performance. However, these strategies are impractical for edge device deployment due to limited RAM and NPU resources. Despite hardware constraints, deploying performant LLM on edge devices such as smartphone remains crucial for user experience. To address this, we propose MeKi (Memory-based Expert Knowledge Injection), a novel system that scales LLM capacity via storage space rather than FLOPs. MeKi equips each Transformer layer with token-level memory experts that injects pre-stored semantic knowledge into the generation process. To bridge the gap between training capacity and inference efficiency, we employ a re-parameterization strategy to fold parameter matrices used during training into a compact static lookup table. By offloading the knowledge to ROM, MeKi decouples model capacity from computational cost, introducing zero inference latency overhead. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MeKi significantly outperforms dense LLM baselines with identical inference speed, validating the effectiveness of memory-based scaling paradigm for on-device LLMs. Project homepage is at https://github.com/ningding-o/MeKi.

AI.tldr: MeKi提出了一种基于存储而非计算扩展LLM能力的新范式，通过ROM中的记忆专家注入语义知识，实现零推理延迟的容量扩展
AI.motivation: 传统LLM扩展依赖增加参数或计算量，这在边缘设备上不实用。需要在有限RAM和NPU资源下部署高性能LLM，提升用户体验
AI.method: MeKi系统为每个Transformer层配备token级记忆专家，注入预存储的语义知识。采用重参数化策略将训练参数矩阵折叠为紧凑静态查找表，将知识卸载到ROM中
AI.result: 实验表明MeKi在相同推理速度下显著优于密集LLM基线，验证了基于内存的扩展范式在设备端LLM中的有效性
AI.conclusion: MeKi通过存储空间而非FLOPs扩展LLM容量，将模型容量与计算成本解耦，为零延迟推理的设备端LLM部署提供了新思路

title: A Geometry-Aware Efficient Algorithm for Compositional Entropic Risk Minimization
summary: This paper studies optimization for a family of problems termed $\textbf{compositional entropic risk minimization}$, in which each data's loss is formulated as a Log-Expectation-Exponential (Log-E-Exp) function. The Log-E-Exp formulation serves as an abstraction of the Log-Sum-Exponential (LogSumExp) function when the explicit summation inside the logarithm is taken over a gigantic number of items and is therefore expensive to evaluate. While entropic risk objectives of this form arise in many machine learning problems, existing optimization algorithms suffer from several fundamental limitations including non-convergence, numerical instability, and slow convergence rates. To address these limitations, we propose a geometry-aware stochastic algorithm, termed $\textbf{SCENT}$, for the dual formulation of entropic risk minimization cast as a min--min optimization problem. The key to our design is a $\textbf{stochastic proximal mirror descent (SPMD)}$ update for the dual variable, equipped with a Bregman divergence induced by a negative exponential function that faithfully captures the geometry of the objective. Our main contributions are threefold: (i) we establish an $O(1/\sqrt{T})$ convergence rate of the proposed SCENT algorithm for convex problems; (ii) we theoretically characterize the advantages of SPMD over standard SGD update for optimizing the dual variable; and (iii) we demonstrate the empirical effectiveness of SCENT on extreme classification, partial AUC maximization, contrastive learning and distributionally robust optimization, where it consistently outperforms existing baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出SCENT算法解决组合熵风险最小化问题，采用随机近端镜像下降更新对偶变量，在凸问题上达到O(1/√T)收敛率，并在多个机器学习任务中优于现有基线
AI.motivation: 组合熵风险最小化问题中的Log-E-Exp函数是LogSumExp函数的抽象，当对数内求和项数量巨大时计算昂贵。现有优化算法存在不收敛、数值不稳定和收敛速度慢等基本限制
AI.method: 提出SCENT算法，将熵风险最小化转化为min-min优化问题的对偶形式，采用由负指数函数诱导的Bregman散度的随机近端镜像下降(SPMD)更新对偶变量，以准确捕捉目标函数的几何结构
AI.result: 理论证明：1) SCENT在凸问题上达到O(1/√T)收敛率；2) SPMD在优化对偶变量方面优于标准SGD更新；3) 在极端分类、部分AUC最大化、对比学习和分布鲁棒优化等任务中，SCENT始终优于现有基线方法
AI.conclusion: SCENT算法通过几何感知的随机优化方法有效解决了组合熵风险最小化问题，克服了现有方法的局限性，在理论和实证上都表现出优越性能

title: When Single Answer Is Not Enough: Rethinking Single-Step Retrosynthesis Benchmarks for LLMs
summary: Recent progress has expanded the use of large language models (LLMs) in drug discovery, including synthesis planning. However, objective evaluation of retrosynthesis performance remains limited. Existing benchmarks and metrics typically rely on published synthetic procedures and Top-K accuracy based on single ground-truth, which does not capture the open-ended nature of real-world synthesis planning. We propose a new benchmarking framework for single-step retrosynthesis that evaluates both general-purpose and chemistry-specialized LLMs using ChemCensor, a novel metric for chemical plausibility. By emphasizing plausibility over exact match, this approach better aligns with human synthesis planning practices. We also introduce CREED, a novel dataset comprising millions of ChemCensor-validated reaction records for LLM training, and use it to train a model that improves over the LLM baselines under this benchmark.

AI.tldr: 提出新的单步逆合成基准框架，使用ChemCensor评估化学合理性而非精确匹配，并引入CREED数据集训练改进模型
AI.motivation: 现有逆合成评估主要依赖已发表合成程序和基于单一真实结果的Top-K准确率，无法捕捉真实世界合成规划的开放性本质，需要更符合人类合成实践的评价方法
AI.method: 提出单步逆合成基准框架，使用ChemCensor作为化学合理性度量标准，强调合理性而非精确匹配；引入CREED数据集（数百万个经ChemCensor验证的反应记录）用于LLM训练
AI.result: 使用CREED数据集训练的模型在基准测试中优于LLM基线，证明新评估框架能更好反映真实合成规划性能
AI.conclusion: 通过强调化学合理性而非精确匹配的新基准框架，能更客观评估逆合成性能，CREED数据集和ChemCensor指标为LLM在药物发现中的应用提供了更实用的评估工具

title: Mixture of Concept Bottleneck Experts
summary: Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs) promote interpretability by grounding predictions in human-understandable concepts. However, existing CBMs typically fix their task predictor to a single linear or Boolean expression, limiting both predictive accuracy and adaptability to diverse user needs. We propose Mixture of Concept Bottleneck Experts (M-CBEs), a framework that generalizes existing CBMs along two dimensions: the number of experts and the functional form of each expert, exposing an underexplored region of the design space. We investigate this region by instantiating two novel models: Linear M-CBE, which learns a finite set of linear expressions, and Symbolic M-CBE, which leverages symbolic regression to discover expert functions from data under user-specified operator vocabularies. Empirical evaluation demonstrates that varying the mixture size and functional form provides a robust framework for navigating the accuracy-interpretability trade-off, adapting to different user and task needs.

AI.tldr: 提出M-CBEs框架，通过混合专家模型和多功能形式扩展概念瓶颈模型，提升预测准确性和用户适应性
AI.motivation: 现有概念瓶颈模型通常将任务预测器固定为单一线性或布尔表达式，限制了预测准确性和对多样化用户需求的适应性
AI.method: 提出混合概念瓶颈专家框架，从专家数量和功能形式两个维度扩展CBMs，实例化线性M-CBE和符号M-CBE两种模型
AI.result: 实验评估表明，通过调整混合规模和功能形式，能够有效导航准确性与可解释性之间的权衡，适应不同用户和任务需求
AI.conclusion: M-CBEs框架为概念瓶颈模型提供了更灵活的设计空间，在保持可解释性的同时提升了预测性能和对用户需求的适应性

title: Self-Soupervision: Cooking Model Soups without Labels
summary: Model soups are strange and strangely effective combinations of parameters. They take a model (the stock), fine-tune it into multiple models (the ingredients), and then mix their parameters back into one model (the soup) to improve predictions. While all known soups require supervised learning, and optimize the same loss on labeled data, our recipes for Self-\emph{Soup}ervision generalize soups to self-supervised learning (SSL). Our Self-Souping lets us flavor ingredients on new data sources, e.g. from unlabeled data from a task for transfer or from a shift for robustness. We show that Self-Souping on corrupted test data, then fine-tuning back on uncorrupted train data, boosts robustness by +3.5\% (ImageNet-C) and +7\% (LAION-C). Self-\emph{Soup}ervision also unlocks countless SSL algorithms to cook the diverse ingredients needed for more robust soups. We show for the first time that ingredients can differ in their SSL hyperparameters -- and more surprisingly, in their SSL algorithms. We cook soups of MAE, MoCoV3, and MMCR ingredients that are more accurate than any one single SSL ingredient.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出Self-Souping方法，将模型汤技术从监督学习扩展到自监督学习，通过在未标记数据上训练不同成分并混合参数来提升模型鲁棒性和准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有模型汤方法仅限于监督学习，且需要优化相同损失函数。作者希望将模型汤技术扩展到自监督学习领域，利用未标记数据（如任务转移数据或分布偏移数据）来创建更鲁棒的模型。
AI.method: 提出Self-Souping方法：1）在基础模型（stock）上使用自监督学习训练多个成分（ingredients）；2）允许成分在SSL超参数和算法上存在差异；3）将不同成分的参数混合成单一模型（soup）；4）在测试数据上应用Self-Souping后，再在干净训练数据上进行微调。
AI.result: 1）在ImageNet-C上鲁棒性提升+3.5%，在LAION-C上提升+7%；2）首次证明成分可以在SSL超参数和算法上存在差异；3）混合MAE、MoCoV3和MMCR等不同SSL算法的成分比任何单一SSL成分更准确。
AI.conclusion: Self-Souping成功将模型汤技术扩展到自监督学习领域，通过利用未标记数据和不同SSL算法创建多样化成分，显著提升了模型鲁棒性和准确性，为模型集成提供了新范式。

title: Conflict-Resolving and Sharpness-Aware Minimization for Generalized Knowledge Editing with Multiple Updates
summary: Large language models (LLMs) rely on internal knowledge to solve many downstream tasks, making it crucial to keep them up to date. Since full retraining is expensive, prior work has explored efficient alternatives such as model editing and parameter-efficient fine-tuning. However, these approaches often break down in practice due to poor generalization across inputs, limited stability, and knowledge conflict. To address these limitations, we propose the CoRSA (Conflict-Resolving and Sharpness-Aware Minimization) training framework, a parameter-efficient, holistic approach for knowledge editing with multiple updates. CoRSA tackles multiple challenges simultaneously: it improves generalization to different input forms and enhances stability across multiple updates by minimizing loss curvature, and resolves conflicts by maximizing the margin between new and prior knowledge. Across three widely used fact editing benchmarks, CoRSA achieves significant gains in generalization, outperforming baselines with average absolute improvements of 12.42% over LoRA and 10% over model editing methods. With multiple updates, it maintains high update efficacy while reducing catastrophic forgetting by 27.82% compared to LoRA. CoRSA also generalizes to the code domain, outperforming the strongest baseline by 5.48% Pass@5 in update efficacy.

AI.tldr: CoRSA训练框架：一种参数高效、整体性的知识编辑方法，通过解决冲突和锐度感知最小化来提升LLM知识更新的泛化性、稳定性和冲突解决能力
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型依赖内部知识解决下游任务，需要保持知识更新。完全重新训练成本高昂，现有方法（模型编辑和参数高效微调）在实践中存在泛化性差、稳定性有限和知识冲突等问题，需要更有效的知识更新方法
AI.method: 提出CoRSA（冲突解决和锐度感知最小化）训练框架：1）通过最小化损失曲率来提升不同输入形式的泛化性和多轮更新的稳定性；2）通过最大化新旧知识之间的边界来解决知识冲突；3）采用参数高效的方法进行知识编辑
AI.result: 在三个广泛使用的事实编辑基准测试中：1）泛化性显著提升，平均绝对改进12.42%（相比LoRA）和10%（相比模型编辑方法）；2）多轮更新中保持高更新效能，灾难性遗忘减少27.82%（相比LoRA）；3）在代码领域也有效，Pass@5更新效能提升5.48%
AI.conclusion: CoRSA框架通过同时解决泛化性、稳定性和知识冲突问题，为LLM知识更新提供了有效的参数高效解决方案，在事实编辑和代码领域都表现出优越性能

title: Controlled disagreement improves generalization in decentralized training
summary: Decentralized training is often regarded as inferior to centralized training because the consensus errors between workers are thought to undermine convergence and generalization, even with homogeneous data distributions. This work challenges this view by introducing decentralized SGD with Adaptive Consensus (DSGD-AC), which intentionally preserves non-vanishing consensus errors through a time-dependent scaling mechanism. We prove that these errors are not random noise but systematically align with the dominant Hessian subspace, acting as structured perturbations that guide optimization toward flatter minima. Across image classification and machine translation benchmarks, DSGD-AC consistently surpasses both standard DSGD and centralized SGD in test accuracy and solution flatness. Together, these results establish consensus errors as a useful implicit regularizer and open a new perspective on the design of decentralized learning algorithms.

AI.tldr: DSGD-AC通过有意保留非零共识误差作为结构化扰动，引导优化趋向平坦最小值，在图像分类和机器翻译任务中超越标准DSGD和集中式SGD
AI.motivation: 挑战传统观点：去中心化训练通常被认为劣于集中式训练，因为共识误差被认为会损害收敛和泛化能力。本文质疑这一观点，认为共识误差可能具有正则化作用
AI.method: 提出DSGD-AC（去中心化SGD与自适应共识），通过时间相关的缩放机制有意保留非零共识误差。证明这些误差不是随机噪声，而是与主导Hessian子空间对齐的结构化扰动
AI.result: 在图像分类和机器翻译基准测试中，DSGD-AC在测试准确率和解平坦度方面一致超越标准DSGD和集中式SGD
AI.conclusion: 共识误差是有用的隐式正则化器，为去中心化学习算法的设计提供了新视角

title: Manifold-Constrained Energy-Based Transition Models for Offline Reinforcement Learning
summary: Model-based offline reinforcement learning is brittle under distribution shift: policy improvement drives rollouts into state--action regions weakly supported by the dataset, where compounding model error yields severe value overestimation. We propose Manifold-Constrained Energy-based Transition Models (MC-ETM), which train conditional energy-based transition models using a manifold projection--diffusion negative sampler. MC-ETM learns a latent manifold of next states and generates near-manifold hard negatives by perturbing latent codes and running Langevin dynamics in latent space with the learned conditional energy, sharpening the energy landscape around the dataset support and improving sensitivity to subtle out-of-distribution deviations. For policy optimization, the learned energy provides a single reliability signal: rollouts are truncated when the minimum energy over sampled next states exceeds a threshold, and Bellman backups are stabilized via pessimistic penalties based on Q-value-level dispersion across energy-guided samples. We formalize MC-ETM through a hybrid pessimistic MDP formulation and derive a conservative performance bound separating in-support evaluation error from truncation risk. Empirically, MC-ETM improves multi-step dynamics fidelity and yields higher normalized returns on standard offline control benchmarks, particularly under irregular dynamics and sparse data coverage.

AI.tldr: MC-ETM提出基于流形约束的能量转移模型，通过流形投影-扩散负采样训练条件能量转移模型，利用学习到的能量作为可靠性信号进行策略优化，解决离线强化学习中分布偏移导致的模型误差和价值高估问题。
AI.motivation: 基于模型的离线强化学习在分布偏移下很脆弱：策略改进会将rollout驱动到数据集支持较弱的状态-动作区域，其中复合模型误差会导致严重的价值高估问题。
AI.method: 1. 训练条件能量转移模型，学习下一个状态的潜在流形；2. 通过扰动潜在代码并在潜在空间中运行Langevin动力学生成近流形硬负样本；3. 使用学习到的能量作为可靠性信号：当采样下一个状态的最小能量超过阈值时截断rollout；4. 基于Q值在能量引导样本上的分散度进行悲观惩罚来稳定Bellman备份。
AI.result: MC-ETM提高了多步动态保真度，在标准离线控制基准测试中获得了更高的归一化回报，特别是在不规则动态和稀疏数据覆盖情况下表现更优。
AI.conclusion: MC-ETM通过混合悲观MDP公式化和保守性能界限，有效分离了支持内评估误差和截断风险，为解决离线强化学习中的分布偏移问题提供了有效方法。

title: Bridging Online and Offline RL: Contextual Bandit Learning for Multi-Turn Code Generation
summary: Recently, there have been significant research interests in training large language models (LLMs) with reinforcement learning (RL) on real-world tasks, such as multi-turn code generation. While online RL tends to perform better than offline RL, its higher training cost and instability hinders wide adoption. In this paper, we build on the observation that multi-turn code generation can be formulated as a one-step recoverable Markov decision process and propose contextual bandit learning with offline trajectories (Cobalt), a new method that combines the benefits of online and offline RL. Cobalt first collects code generation trajectories using a reference LLM and divides them into partial trajectories as contextual prompts. Then, during online bandit learning, the LLM is trained to complete each partial trajectory prompt through single-step code generation. Cobalt outperforms two multi-turn online RL baselines based on GRPO and VeRPO, and substantially improves R1-Distill 8B and Qwen3 8B by up to 9.0 and 6.2 absolute Pass@1 scores on LiveCodeBench. Also, we analyze LLMs' in-context reward hacking behaviors and augment Cobalt training with perturbed trajectories to mitigate this issue. Overall, our results demonstrate Cobalt as a promising solution for iterative decision-making tasks like multi-turn code generation. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/OSU-NLP-Group/cobalt.

AI.tldr: Cobalt：一种结合在线和离线强化学习优势的新方法，用于多轮代码生成任务，通过上下文赌博机学习和离线轨迹实现高效训练。
AI.motivation: 虽然在线强化学习在多轮代码生成等现实任务中表现优于离线强化学习，但其较高的训练成本和不稳定性限制了广泛应用。因此需要一种结合两者优势的新方法。
AI.method: 将多轮代码生成建模为一步可恢复马尔可夫决策过程，提出Cobalt方法：1）使用参考LLM收集代码生成轨迹并划分为部分轨迹作为上下文提示；2）在线赌博机学习中，训练LLM通过单步代码生成完成每个部分轨迹提示；3）分析LLM的上下文奖励黑客行为，并通过扰动轨迹增强训练来缓解该问题。
AI.result: Cobalt在LiveCodeBench上优于基于GRPO和VeRPO的多轮在线RL基线，将R1-Distill 8B和Qwen3 8B的绝对Pass@1分数分别提升了9.0和6.2。通过扰动轨迹增强了对抗奖励黑客行为的能力。
AI.conclusion: Cobalt是多轮代码生成等迭代决策任务的有前景解决方案，有效结合了在线和离线RL的优势，降低了训练成本并提高了稳定性。

title: A Random Matrix Theory Perspective on the Consistency of Diffusion Models
summary: Diffusion models trained on different, non-overlapping subsets of a dataset often produce strikingly similar outputs when given the same noise seed. We trace this consistency to a simple linear effect: the shared Gaussian statistics across splits already predict much of the generated images. To formalize this, we develop a random matrix theory (RMT) framework that quantifies how finite datasets shape the expectation and variance of the learned denoiser and sampling map in the linear setting. For expectations, sampling variability acts as a renormalization of the noise level through a self-consistent relation $σ^2 \mapsto κ(σ^2)$, explaining why limited data overshrink low-variance directions and pull samples toward the dataset mean. For fluctuations, our variance formulas reveal three key factors behind cross-split disagreement: \textit{anisotropy} across eigenmodes, \textit{inhomogeneity} across inputs, and overall scaling with dataset size. Extending deterministic-equivalence tools to fractional matrix powers further allows us to analyze entire sampling trajectories. The theory sharply predicts the behavior of linear diffusion models, and we validate its predictions on UNet and DiT architectures in their non-memorization regime, identifying where and how samples deviates across training data split. This provides a principled baseline for reproducibility in diffusion training, linking spectral properties of data to the stability of generative outputs.

AI.tldr: 扩散模型在不同非重叠数据子集上训练时，给定相同噪声种子会产生惊人相似的输出。这种一致性源于数据集的共享高斯统计特性，作者通过随机矩阵理论框架量化了有限数据集如何影响线性设置中去噪器和采样图的期望与方差。
AI.motivation: 研究扩散模型在不同训练数据子集上训练时输出一致性的原因，理解有限数据集如何影响生成过程的统计特性，为扩散训练的可重复性建立理论基础。
AI.method: 开发随机矩阵理论框架，分析线性扩散模型中有限数据集对去噪器和采样图期望与方差的影响。使用确定性等价工具扩展到分数矩阵幂，分析整个采样轨迹。在UNet和DiT架构的非记忆化区域验证理论预测。
AI.result: 理论预测了线性扩散模型的行为，揭示了跨训练数据分割样本偏差的三个关键因素：特征模态的各向异性、输入间的非均匀性以及数据集大小的整体缩放。验证表明理论能准确预测实际架构中的行为。
AI.conclusion: 扩散模型输出的一致性源于数据集的共享高斯统计特性，随机矩阵理论为理解有限数据集如何影响生成过程提供了量化框架，建立了数据谱特性与生成输出稳定性之间的联系，为扩散训练的可重复性提供了理论基础。

title: Notes on the Reward Representation of Posterior Updates
summary: Many ideas in modern control and reinforcement learning treat decision-making as inference: start from a baseline distribution and update it when a signal arrives. We ask when this can be made literal rather than metaphorical. We study the special case where a KL-regularized soft update is exactly a Bayesian posterior inside a single fixed probabilistic model, so the update variable is a genuine channel through which information is transmitted. In this regime, behavioral change is driven only by evidence carried by that channel: the update must be explainable as an evidence reweighing of the baseline. This yields a sharp identification result: posterior updates determine the relative, context-dependent incentive signal that shifts behavior, but they do not uniquely determine absolute rewards, which remain ambiguous up to context-specific baselines. Requiring one reusable continuation value across different update directions adds a further coherence constraint linking the reward descriptions associated with different conditioning orders.

AI.tldr: 论文探讨了何时可以将决策作为推断这一概念从隐喻变为字面意义，研究KL正则化软更新在单一固定概率模型中恰好是贝叶斯后验的情况，此时更新变量成为真正的信息传输通道。
AI.motivation: 现代控制和强化学习中的许多思想将决策视为推断：从基线分布开始，在信号到达时更新它。本文旨在探讨何时可以将这种"决策作为推断"的概念从隐喻变为字面意义，研究在什么条件下KL正则化软更新能够精确对应单一固定概率模型中的贝叶斯后验。
AI.method: 研究KL正则化软更新在单一固定概率模型中恰好是贝叶斯后验的特殊情况。在这种机制下，更新变量成为真正的信息传输通道，行为变化仅由该通道携带的证据驱动。分析更新必须解释为基线证据重新加权的要求，推导出尖锐的识别结果。
AI.result: 后验更新确定了驱动行为变化的相对、上下文相关的激励信号，但无法唯一确定绝对奖励，后者在上下文特定基线范围内保持模糊。要求在不同更新方向上可重用的延续值添加了进一步的一致性约束，将不同条件顺序相关的奖励描述联系起来。
AI.conclusion: 当KL正则化软更新在单一固定概率模型中恰好是贝叶斯后验时，决策作为推断可以从隐喻变为字面意义。这种机制下，行为变化仅由证据通道驱动，后验更新确定了相对激励信号但无法唯一确定绝对奖励，而可重用延续值的要求添加了额外的一致性约束。

title: Weighted Temporal Decay Loss for Learning Wearable PPG Data with Sparse Clinical Labels
summary: Advances in wearable computing and AI have increased interest in leveraging PPG for health monitoring over the past decade. One of the biggest challenges in developing health algorithms based on such biosignals is the sparsity of clinical labels, which makes biosignals temporally distant from lab draws less reliable for supervision. To address this problem, we introduce a simple training strategy that learns a biomarker-specific decay of sample weight over the time gap between a segment and its ground truth label and uses this weight in the loss with a regularizer to prevent trivial solutions. On smartwatch PPG from 450 participants across 10 biomarkers, the approach improves over baselines. In the subject-wise setting, the proposed approach averages 0.715 AUPRC, compared to 0.674 for a fine-tuned self-supervised baseline and 0.626 for a feature-based Random Forest. A comparison of four decay families shows that a simple linear decay function is most robust on average. Beyond accuracy, the learned decay rates summarize how quickly each biomarker's PPG evidence becomes stale, providing an interpretable view of temporal sensitivity.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于PPG信号和临床标签时间间隔的样本权重衰减训练策略，用于解决生物信号与实验室标签时间不匹配导致的监督不可靠问题。
AI.motivation: 可穿戴设备和AI的发展推动了基于PPG的健康监测，但临床标签的稀疏性使得远离实验室抽血时间的生物信号监督不可靠，需要解决时间间隔对监督信号质量的影响。
AI.method: 提出一种训练策略，学习特定生物标志物的样本权重随信号段与真实标签时间间隔的衰减函数，在损失函数中使用该权重并添加正则化防止平凡解。在450名参与者的智能手表PPG数据上测试了10种生物标志物。
AI.result: 在受试者层面的设置中，该方法平均AUPRC达到0.715，优于微调的自监督基线（0.674）和基于特征的随机森林（0.626）。线性衰减函数在四种衰减函数家族中表现最稳健。
AI.conclusion: 该方法不仅提高了准确性，学习到的衰减率还量化了每种生物标志物PPG证据随时间失效的速度，提供了对时间敏感性的可解释视角。

title: A Reproducible Framework for Bias-Resistant Machine Learning on Small-Sample Neuroimaging Data
comment: Accepted to ISBI 2026, 5 pages with 1 figure
summary: We introduce a reproducible, bias-resistant machine learning framework that integrates domain-informed feature engineering, nested cross-validation, and calibrated decision-threshold optimization for small-sample neuroimaging data. Conventional cross-validation frameworks that reuse the same folds for both model selection and performance estimation yield optimistically biased results, limiting reproducibility and generalization. Demonstrated on a high-dimensional structural MRI dataset of deep brain stimulation cognitive outcomes, the framework achieved a nested-CV balanced accuracy of 0.660\,$\pm$\,0.068 using a compact, interpretable subset selected via importance-guided ranking. By combining interpretability and unbiased evaluation, this work provides a generalizable computational blueprint for reliable machine learning in data-limited biomedical domains.

AI.tldr: 提出一个可重复、抗偏倚的机器学习框架，整合领域知识特征工程、嵌套交叉验证和校准决策阈值优化，用于小样本神经影像数据。
AI.motivation: 传统交叉验证框架重复使用相同折数进行模型选择和性能评估会产生乐观偏倚结果，限制了可重复性和泛化能力，特别是在小样本生物医学数据中。
AI.method: 整合领域知识特征工程、嵌套交叉验证和校准决策阈值优化；使用重要性引导排序选择紧凑可解释的特征子集；在深部脑刺激认知结果的高维结构MRI数据集上验证。
AI.result: 框架在嵌套交叉验证中达到平衡准确率0.660±0.068，使用通过重要性引导排序选择的紧凑可解释特征子集。
AI.conclusion: 通过结合可解释性和无偏评估，该工作为数据有限的生物医学领域提供了可靠机器学习的通用计算蓝图。

title: How Does the Lagrangian Guide Safe Reinforcement Learning through Diffusion Models?
summary: Diffusion policy sampling enables reinforcement learning (RL) to represent multimodal action distributions beyond suboptimal unimodal Gaussian policies. However, existing diffusion-based RL methods primarily focus on offline settings for reward maximization, with limited consideration of safety in online settings. To address this gap, we propose Augmented Lagrangian-Guided Diffusion (ALGD), a novel algorithm for off-policy safe RL. By revisiting optimization theory and energy-based model, we show that the instability of primal-dual methods arises from the non-convex Lagrangian landscape. In diffusion-based safe RL, the Lagrangian can be interpreted as an energy function guiding the denoising dynamics. Counterintuitively, direct usage destabilizes both policy generation and training. ALGD resolves this issue by introducing an augmented Lagrangian that locally convexifies the energy landscape, yielding a stabilized policy generation and training process without altering the distribution of the optimal policy. Theoretical analysis and extensive experiments demonstrate that ALGD is both theoretically grounded and empirically effective, achieving strong and stable performance across diverse environments.

AI.tldr: 提出ALGD算法，通过增强拉格朗日方法稳定扩散策略在安全强化学习中的应用，解决传统方法训练不稳定的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有基于扩散的强化学习方法主要关注离线设置下的奖励最大化，对在线环境中的安全性考虑有限。传统方法在安全强化学习中存在训练不稳定的问题，需要新的解决方案。
AI.method: 提出增强拉格朗日引导扩散（ALGD）算法，通过引入增强拉格朗日函数局部凸化能量景观，稳定策略生成和训练过程，而不改变最优策略的分布。
AI.result: 理论分析和大量实验表明ALGD具有理论基础和实证有效性，在多样化环境中实现了强大而稳定的性能表现。
AI.conclusion: ALGD通过增强拉格朗日方法成功解决了扩散策略在安全强化学习中的稳定性问题，为安全强化学习提供了新的有效解决方案。

title: Distance Marching for Generative Modeling
summary: Time-unconditional generative models learn time-independent denoising vector fields. But without time conditioning, the same noisy input may correspond to multiple noise levels and different denoising directions, which interferes with the supervision signal. Inspired by distance field modeling, we propose Distance Marching, a new time-unconditional approach with two principled inference methods. Crucially, we design losses that focus on closer targets. This yields denoising directions better directed toward the data manifold. Across architectures, Distance Marching consistently improves FID by 13.5% on CIFAR-10 and ImageNet over recent time-unconditional baselines. For class-conditional ImageNet generation, despite removing time input, Distance Marching surpasses flow matching using our losses and inference methods. It achieves lower FID than flow matching's final performance using 60% of the sampling steps and 13.6% lower FID on average across backbone sizes. Moreover, our distance prediction is also helpful for early stopping during sampling and for OOD detection. We hope distance field modeling can serve as a principled lens for generative modeling.

AI.tldr: 提出Distance Marching方法，一种无需时间条件的时间无关生成模型，通过距离场建模改进去噪方向，在多个数据集上超越现有时间无关基线，甚至在某些方面优于时间条件方法。
AI.motivation: 时间无关生成模型学习时间独立的去噪向量场，但缺乏时间条件会导致相同噪声输入对应多个噪声水平和不同去噪方向，这会干扰监督信号。需要解决这一根本问题。
AI.method: 提出Distance Marching方法，受距离场建模启发，包含两种原则性推理方法。关键设计是专注于更近目标的损失函数，使去噪方向更好地指向数据流形。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10和ImageNet上，Distance Marching相比近期时间无关基线FID持续提升13.5%。对于类别条件ImageNet生成，尽管移除了时间输入，但通过损失和推理方法超越了流匹配。使用60%采样步数达到流匹配最终性能，且在不同骨干大小上平均FID降低13.6%。距离预测还有助于采样中的早期停止和OOD检测。
AI.conclusion: 距离场建模可以作为生成建模的原则性视角，Distance Marching方法在时间无关生成模型中表现出显著优势，为生成建模提供了新的思路。

title: RPG-AE: Neuro-Symbolic Graph Autoencoders with Rare Pattern Mining for Provenance-Based Anomaly Detection
summary: Advanced Persistent Threats (APTs) are sophisticated, long-term cyberattacks that are difficult to detect because they operate stealthily and often blend into normal system behavior. This paper presents a neuro-symbolic anomaly detection framework that combines a Graph Autoencoder (GAE) with rare pattern mining to identify APT-like activities in system-level provenance data. Our approach first constructs a process behavioral graph using k-Nearest Neighbors based on feature similarity, then learns normal relational structure using a Graph Autoencoder. Anomaly candidates are identified through deviations between observed and reconstructed graph structure. To further improve detection, we integrate an rare pattern mining module that discovers infrequent behavioral co-occurrences and uses them to boost anomaly scores for processes exhibiting rare signatures. We evaluate the proposed method on the DARPA Transparent Computing datasets and show that rare-pattern boosting yields substantial gains in anomaly ranking quality over the baseline GAE. Compared with existing unsupervised approaches on the same benchmark, our single unified model consistently outperforms individual context-based detectors and achieves performance competitive with ensemble aggregation methods that require multiple separate detectors. These results highlight the value of coupling graph-based representation learning with classical pattern mining to improve both effectiveness and interpretability in provenance-based security anomaly detection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合图自编码器与稀有模式挖掘的神经符号异常检测框架，用于在系统级溯源数据中识别APT类活动，在DARPA透明计算数据集上验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 高级持续性威胁（APTs）具有隐蔽性强、持续时间长、难以检测的特点，因为它们通常伪装成正常系统行为。现有方法在检测APT类活动方面存在局限性，需要更有效的异常检测框架。
AI.method: 1. 基于特征相似性使用k近邻构建进程行为图；2. 使用图自编码器学习正常关系结构；3. 通过观测图与重构图之间的偏差识别异常候选；4. 集成稀有模式挖掘模块，发现不常见的行为共现模式，并利用这些模式提升具有稀有特征的进程的异常分数。
AI.result: 在DARPA透明计算数据集上的评估表明：1. 稀有模式增强在异常排名质量上相比基线图自编码器有显著提升；2. 单一统一模型在相同基准测试中持续优于基于上下文的单个检测器；3. 性能与需要多个独立检测器的集成聚合方法相当。
AI.conclusion: 将基于图的表示学习与经典模式挖掘相结合，能够有效提升溯源安全异常检测的效果和可解释性，为APT检测提供了有前景的解决方案。

title: Rare Event Early Detection: A Dataset of Sepsis Onset for Critically Ill Trauma Patients
summary: Sepsis is a major public health concern due to its high morbidity, mortality, and cost. Its clinical outcome can be substantially improved through early detection and timely intervention. By leveraging publicly available datasets, machine learning (ML) has driven advances in both research and clinical practice. However, existing public datasets consider ICU patients (Intensive Care Unit) as a uniform group and neglect the potential challenges presented by critically ill trauma patients in whom injury-related inflammation and organ dysfunction can overlap with the clinical features of sepsis. We propose that a targeted identification of post-traumatic sepsis is necessary in order to develop methods for early detection. Therefore, we introduce a publicly available standardized post-trauma sepsis onset dataset extracted, relabeled using standardized post-trauma clinical facts, and validated from MIMIC-III. Furthermore, we frame early detection of post-trauma sepsis onset according to clinical workflow in ICUs in a daily basis resulting in a new rare event detection problem. We then establish a general benchmark through comprehensive experiments, which shows the necessity of further advancements using this new dataset. The data code is available at https://github.com/ML4UWHealth/SepsisOnset_TraumaCohort.git.

AI.tldr: 该研究创建了一个专门针对创伤患者脓毒症的公开数据集，并建立了早期检测基准，以解决现有数据集忽视创伤患者特殊性的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有公开数据集将ICU患者视为同质群体，忽视了创伤危重患者的特殊性。创伤相关的炎症和器官功能障碍可能与脓毒症的临床特征重叠，导致现有方法对创伤后脓毒症的早期检测效果不佳。因此需要专门针对创伤患者的脓毒症数据集来开发更有效的早期检测方法。
AI.method: 从MIMIC-III数据库中提取、重新标注并验证了一个标准化的创伤后脓毒症发病数据集。按照ICU临床工作流程，将创伤后脓毒症的早期检测框架为每日一次的罕见事件检测问题。通过全面实验建立了通用基准。
AI.result: 创建了公开可用的标准化创伤后脓毒症发病数据集，并建立了早期检测的基准。实验结果表明，使用这个新数据集需要进一步的技术进步来改善创伤后脓毒症的早期检测性能。
AI.conclusion: 专门针对创伤患者的脓毒症数据集对于开发有效的早期检测方法至关重要。提出的数据集和基准为未来研究提供了基础，有助于改善创伤患者脓毒症的临床预后。
